::: callout-note
## How to use this quiz

This quiz is designed as a **formative self-assessment tool**, not as a test.

Its purpose is to help you:
- check your understanding of the key concepts from Topic 7,
- identify which types of thinking you find more difficult, and
- guide your revision before the tutorial and future assessments.

### What this quiz measures

Each question belongs to one of four categories:

- **Subject Knowledge (SK):** definitions, concepts, and facts.  
- **Analysis (AN):** understanding relationships and economic mechanisms.  
- **Problem Solving (PS):** applying concepts to new situations.  
- **Mathematical Thinking (MT):** working with equations and quantitative relationships.

Your score will be broken down by category so you can see **where** you are strong and where you need more practice.

### How to complete the quiz

- You may use your notes and the lecture materials.
- Take your time — the goal is understanding, not speed.
- Use the **Hints** if you get stuck.
- You may refresh and retry the quiz as many times as you like.

### How to interpret your results

- A low score is **not a problem** — it tells you what to focus on.
- If you score low in:
  - **SK:** revise definitions and core concepts.
  - **AN:** revisit the logic of the models and examples.
  - **PS:** practise applying concepts to new cases.
  - **MT:** practise the mathematical calculations and equations.

### About the leaderboard

The leaderboard is optional and anonymous. It exists only to make practice more engaging.  
It has **no effect** on your grade and is not used for evaluation.

The only purpose of this quiz is to support your learning.

:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(webexercises)
```

<!-- FEEDBACK SCRIPT: interactive quiz with self-assessment -->
```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  // 1) Configure your Google Apps Script Web App URL here.
  //    Example: https://script.google.com/macros/s/XXXXXXXXXXXX/exec
  const ENDPOINT = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbysCOTW2ZLw5ruYY84Y-o0zB7nt0jkowiC3OoKJSdh2OYv-ZXa_1vTb_TU4BYwcwSZ0Jw/exec";

  const norm = s => (s || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

  function getSelectedLabelText(qEl) {
    const input = qEl.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');
    if (!input) return "";
    const label = input.closest('label') || document.querySelector('label[for="' + input.id + '"]');
    return label ? norm(label.textContent) : "";
  }

  function clearFeedback(qEl) {
    qEl.querySelectorAll("label").forEach(l => l.classList.remove("is-correct", "is-incorrect"));
    const line = qEl.querySelector(".quiz-feedback-line");
    if (line) {
      line.textContent = "";
      line.classList.add("hidden");
    }
  }

  function setFeedback(qEl, isCorrect) {
    const line = qEl.querySelector(".quiz-feedback-line");
    if (!line) return;
    line.textContent = isCorrect ? "Correct." : "Incorrect.";
    line.classList.remove("hidden");
  }

  async function postAttempt(payload) {
    // Do not attempt POST if ENDPOINT is not configured
    if (!ENDPOINT || ENDPOINT.includes("PASTE_YOUR_")) return;

    try {
      await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        mode: "no-cors",
        keepalive: true,
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Could not save attempt:", err);
    }
  }

  async function loadLeaderboard(quizName) {
    const table = document.getElementById("leaderboard");
    if (!table) return;

    // If not configured, show a friendly message and stop.
    if (!ENDPOINT || ENDPOINT.includes("PASTE_YOUR_")) {
      table.innerHTML = "<tr><td>Leaderboard is not configured yet. Add your Apps Script URL in the page source.</td></tr>";
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(ENDPOINT, { method: "GET" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
      const rows = await res.json();

      // Filter for this quiz only (defensive: older rows may not have the fields)
      const filtered = (rows || []).filter(r => String(r.quiz || "") === String(quizName));

      // Keep best score per nickname
      const best = new Map();
      filtered.forEach(r => {
        const nick = String(r.nickname || "").trim();
        if (!nick) return;
        const score = Number(r.score);
        const total = Number(r.total);
        const ts = new Date(r.timestamp || 0).getTime();

        const prev = best.get(nick);
        if (!prev || score > prev.score || (score === prev.score && ts < prev.ts)) {
          best.set(nick, { nickname: nick, score, total, ts });
        }
      });

      const leaderboard = Array.from(best.values())
        .sort((a, b) => (b.score - a.score) || (a.ts - b.ts))
        .slice(0, 30);

      if (leaderboard.length === 0) {
        table.innerHTML = "<tr><td>No attempts recorded yet.</td></tr>";
      } else {
        table.innerHTML =
          "<tr><th>Rank</th><th>Nickname</th><th>Score</th></tr>" +
          leaderboard.map((r, i) =>
            "<tr><td>" + (i + 1) + "</td><td>" + String(r.nickname) + "</td><td>" + r.score + " / " + r.total + "</td></tr>"
          ).join("");
      }

      // Load and display question statistics
      await loadQuestionStats(quizName, rows);
    } catch (err) {
      table.innerHTML = "<tr><td>Could not load leaderboard.</td></tr>";
      console.warn("Leaderboard error:", err);
    }
  }

  async function loadQuestionStats(quizName, allRows) {
    const statsContainer = document.getElementById("question-stats");
    if (!statsContainer) return;

    // Filter for this quiz only
    const filtered = (allRows || []).filter(r => String(r.quiz || "") === String(quizName));

    console.log("=== DEBUGGING QUESTION STATS ===");
    console.log("Filtered rows count:", filtered.length);
    if (filtered.length > 0) {
      console.log("Sample row:", filtered[0]);
    }

    // Build a map of question index to identifier
    const questionIdentifiers = {};
    document.querySelectorAll(".mcq-we-q").forEach((qEl, idx) => {
      const questionText = qEl.querySelector("strong")?.textContent || "";
      const categoryMatch = questionText.match(/^(SK|AN|PS|MT)(\d+)/);
      if (categoryMatch) {
        questionIdentifiers[idx] = categoryMatch[1] + categoryMatch[2];
      } else {
        questionIdentifiers[idx] = "Q" + (idx + 1);
      }
    });

    console.log("Question identifiers map:", questionIdentifiers);

    // Count incorrect attempts per question
    const questionStats = {};
    filtered.forEach((row, rowIdx) => {
      let details = row.details || {};
      
      // If details is a string (JSON), parse it
      if (typeof details === "string") {
        try {
          details = JSON.parse(details);
          console.log(`Row ${rowIdx} - Parsed details from string`);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn(`Row ${rowIdx} - Could not parse details:`, details);
          return;
        }
      }

      console.log(`Row ${rowIdx} - Processing details:`, details);

      Object.entries(details).forEach(([questionId, qData]) => {
        if (!questionStats[questionId]) {
          questionStats[questionId] = { incorrectCount: 0, totalCount: 0 };
        }
        
        questionStats[questionId].totalCount += 1;
        
        // Check if answer was incorrect (ok: 0 means incorrect)
        const isIncorrect = qData.ok === 0;
        if (isIncorrect) {
          questionStats[questionId].incorrectCount += 1;
        }
      });
    });

    console.log("\nFinal question stats:", questionStats);

    // Get top 10 most incorrect questions, sorted by incorrect count
    const sortedQuestions = Object.entries(questionStats)
      .map(([qKey, stats]) => ({
        qKey: qKey,
        incorrectCount: stats.incorrectCount,
        totalCount: stats.totalCount,
        incorrectRate: stats.totalCount > 0 ? (stats.incorrectCount / stats.totalCount * 100).toFixed(1) : 0
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.incorrectCount - a.incorrectCount)
      .slice(0, 10);

    console.log("Sorted questions:", sortedQuestions);

    if (sortedQuestions.length === 0) {
      statsContainer.innerHTML = "<p>No question statistics available yet.</p>";
    } else {
      statsContainer.innerHTML =
        "<h4>Top 10 Questions with Most Incorrect Attempts</h4>" +
        "<table style='width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;'>" +
        "<tr style='border-bottom: 2px solid #ccc;'><th style='text-align: left; padding: 8px;'>Question</th><th style='text-align: center; padding: 8px;'>Incorrect Attempts</th><th style='text-align: center; padding: 8px;'>Total Attempts</th><th style='text-align: center; padding: 8px;'>Incorrect Rate</th></tr>" +
        sortedQuestions.map(q =>
          "<tr style='border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;'>" +
          "<td style='padding: 8px;'>" + String(q.qKey) + "</td>" +
          "<td style='text-align: center; padding: 8px;'>" + q.incorrectCount + "</td>" +
          "<td style='text-align: center; padding: 8px;'>" + q.totalCount + "</td>" +
          "<td style='text-align: center; padding: 8px;'>" + q.incorrectRate + "%</td>" +
          "</tr>"
        ).join("") +
        "</table>";
    }
  }

  async function submitQuiz() {
    const nicknameEl = document.getElementById("nickname");
    const resultEl = document.getElementById("quiz-result");
    const submitBtn = document.getElementById("quiz-submit");

    const nickname = (nicknameEl?.value || "").trim();
    if (!nickname) {
      alert("Please enter a nickname before submitting.");
      nicknameEl?.focus();
      return;
    }

    // Lock submit to avoid double posting
    if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;

    let score = 0;
    let total = 0;
    const details = {};
    
    // Category scores
    const categories = {
      SK: { score: 0, total: 0, name: "Subject Knowledge" },
      AN: { score: 0, total: 0, name: "Analysis" },
      PS: { score: 0, total: 0, name: "Problem Solving" },
      MT: { score: 0, total: 0, name: "Mathematical Thinking" }
    };

    const questions = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".mcq-we-q"));

    // Clear any prior feedback first (important if student re-submits)
    questions.forEach(clearFeedback);

    questions.forEach((qEl, idx) => {
      total += 1;
      const keyEl = qEl.querySelector(".mcq-key");
      const correct = norm(keyEl?.getAttribute("data-correct") || "");
      const selected = getSelectedLabelText(qEl);

      const isCorrect = selected && (selected === correct);
      if (isCorrect) score += 1;

      // Extract category and question ID from question text (SK1, AN1, PS1, MT1, etc.)
      const questionText = qEl.querySelector("strong")?.textContent || "";
      const categoryMatch = questionText.match(/^(SK|AN|PS|MT)(\d+)/);
      let questionId = "Q" + (idx + 1);
      
      if (categoryMatch) {
        const cat = categoryMatch[1];
        const num = categoryMatch[2];
        questionId = cat + num;
        
        categories[cat].total += 1;
        if (isCorrect) categories[cat].score += 1;
      }

      details[questionId] = { selected, correct, ok: isCorrect ? 1 : 0 };

      // Mark only after submit
      if (selected) {
        const input = qEl.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');
        const label = input?.closest("label") || (input ? document.querySelector('label[for="' + input.id + '"]') : null);
        if (label) label.classList.add(isCorrect ? "is-correct" : "is-incorrect");
      }
      setFeedback(qEl, isCorrect);
    });

    if (resultEl) {
      let resultHTML = "<strong>Overall Score: " + score + " / " + total + "</strong><br><br>";
      
      // Add category breakdown
      for (const key in categories) {
        const cat = categories[key];
        if (cat.total > 0) {
          resultHTML += cat.name + ": " + cat.score + " / " + cat.total + "<br>";
        }
      }
      
      // Add correct and incorrect questions
      const correctQuestions = [];
      const incorrectQuestions = [];
      
      questions.forEach((qEl, idx) => {
        const keyEl = qEl.querySelector(".mcq-key");
        const correct = norm(keyEl?.getAttribute("data-correct") || "");
        const selected = getSelectedLabelText(qEl);
        const isCorrect = selected && (selected === correct);
        
        // Extract question ID from question text
        const questionText = qEl.querySelector("strong")?.textContent || "";
        const categoryMatch = questionText.match(/^(SK|AN|PS|MT)(\d+)/);
        let questionId = "Q" + (idx + 1);
        if (categoryMatch) {
          questionId = categoryMatch[1] + categoryMatch[2];
        }
        
        if (selected) {
          if (isCorrect) {
            correctQuestions.push(questionId);
          } else {
            incorrectQuestions.push(questionId);
          }
        }
      });
      
      resultHTML += "<br><strong>Correct Questions:</strong> " + (correctQuestions.length > 0 ? correctQuestions.join(", ") : "None") + "<br>";
      resultHTML += "<strong>Incorrect Questions:</strong> " + (incorrectQuestions.length > 0 ? incorrectQuestions.join(", ") : "None") + "<br>";
      
      resultEl.innerHTML = resultHTML;
    }

    // Persist attempt (best practice: store what you need; nickname only = low GDPR footprint)
    await postAttempt({
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      nickname,
      quiz: "Topic7",
      score,
      total,
      details
    });

    // Refresh leaderboard after a successful submit (or best-effort submit)
    await loadLeaderboard("Topic7");

    // Disable all radio buttons and submit button to prevent further changes
    document.querySelectorAll(".mcq-we-q input[type='radio']").forEach(input => {
      input.disabled = true;
    });
    if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;
  }

  // Expose submitQuiz globally for the button onclick
  window.submitQuiz = submitQuiz;

  // Add a feedback line container to each question if it doesn't exist
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    document.querySelectorAll(".mcq-we-q").forEach(qEl => {
      if (!qEl.querySelector(".quiz-feedback-line")) {
        const line = document.createElement("div");
        line.className = "quiz-feedback-line hidden";
        qEl.appendChild(line);
      }
    });

    loadLeaderboard("Topic7");
  });
})();
</script>
```

## Subject Knowledge

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK1) Financial intermediation primarily refers to:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Government taxation", answer = "The process by which banks channel funds from savers to borrowers", "The printing of money by the central bank", "The determination of exchange rates"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="The process by which banks channel funds from savers to borrowers"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Think about how surplus units and deficit units are connected in the economy.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK2) A bank's balance sheet identity requires that:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Loans equal deposits", answer = "Assets equal liabilities plus equity", "Reserves equal profits", "Equity equals deposits"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Assets equal liabilities plus equity"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Apply the basic accounting constraint for any financial institution.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK3) Bank reserves are best described as:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Loans to households", "Physical capital", answer = "Deposits held at the central bank", "Government spending"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Deposits held at the central bank"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Distinguish between central bank money and commercial bank assets.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK4) The money multiplier links:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Fiscal deficits to inflation", answer = "The monetary base to broad money", "Output to unemployment", "Interest rates to exchange rates"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="The monetary base to broad money"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Broad money expands based on reserve holdings and deposit creation.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK5) Liquidity risk arises when:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("A bank's assets fall in value permanently", "Borrowers default on loans", answer = "A bank cannot meet short-term withdrawal demands", "Inflation rises unexpectedly"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="A bank cannot meet short-term withdrawal demands"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Focus on timing mismatches between assets and liabilities.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK6) Capital adequacy requirements are designed to:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Increase inflation", answer = "Reduce the probability of bank insolvency", "Eliminate monetary policy", "Fix exchange rates"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Reduce the probability of bank insolvency"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Equity buffers absorb unexpected losses.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK7) A bank run occurs when:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Interest rates rise", answer = "Depositors simultaneously withdraw funds due to loss of confidence", "Government spending falls", "Inflation becomes negative"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Depositors simultaneously withdraw funds due to loss of confidence"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Expectations and coordination problems are central.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK8) Deposit insurance primarily aims to:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Increase bank profits", "Eliminate inflation", answer = "Prevent self-fulfilling bank runs", "Fix the money supply"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Prevent self-fulfilling bank runs"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Consider coordination failures among depositors.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK9) Moral hazard in banking arises because:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Interest rates are fixed", answer = "Insured banks may take excessive risk", "Inflation is volatile", "Capital flows are restricted"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Insured banks may take excessive risk"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Protection from losses may weaken incentives.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**SK10) The lender of last resort function of the central bank involves:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Financing fiscal deficits permanently", answer = "Providing liquidity to solvent but illiquid banks", "Setting exchange rate pegs", "Controlling wages"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Providing liquidity to solvent but illiquid banks"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Distinguish liquidity problems from solvency problems.</details>
</div>

## Analysis

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN1) Why can maturity transformation make banks vulnerable to runs?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Because assets and liabilities have identical maturities", answer = "Because long-term loans are funded by short-term deposits", "Because banks hold only cash", "Because equity equals zero"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Because long-term loans are funded by short-term deposits"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Compare withdrawal timing with asset liquidity.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN2) If deposit insurance is credible, the probability of a bank run decreases because:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Banks hold no risky assets", answer = "Depositors expect guaranteed repayment", "Loans become risk-free", "Inflation falls"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Depositors expect guaranteed repayment"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Expectations shape withdrawal incentives.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN3) Why might high leverage amplify financial crises?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c(answer = "Because equity buffers are small relative to assets", "Because inflation is high", "Because reserves are unlimited", "Because velocity increases"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Because equity buffers are small relative to assets"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Losses represent a larger fraction of capital when leverage is high.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN4) If asset values fall sharply, what happens first on a bank's balance sheet?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Liabilities automatically fall", answer = "Equity absorbs the loss", "Deposits increase", "Reserves double"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Equity absorbs the loss"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Apply the accounting identity.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN5) Why can deposit insurance create moral hazard?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Because banks cannot lend", answer = "Because insured depositors stop monitoring risk-taking", "Because capital requirements disappear", "Because inflation rises"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Because insured depositors stop monitoring risk-taking"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Risk monitoring depends on exposure to losses.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN6) If a central bank lends freely at a penalty rate during a crisis, what principle is it following?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Quantity theory", answer = "Bagehot's rule", "Taylor principle", "PPP"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Bagehot's rule"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Provide liquidity but discourage excessive risk.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN7) Why can interconnectedness between banks transmit shocks?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Because reserves are infinite", answer = "Because losses in one institution reduce asset values of others", "Because interest rates fall", "Because inflation stabilises"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Because losses in one institution reduce asset values of others"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Think about interbank exposures.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN8) If capital requirements increase, banks may reduce lending in the short run because:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c(answer = "They must improve capital ratios", "Inflation falls", "Deposits disappear", "Velocity collapses"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="They must improve capital ratios"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Adjust either the numerator (equity) or denominator (assets).</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN9) Why can a liquidity crisis become a solvency crisis?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Because inflation rises", answer = "Because fire sales reduce asset prices below fundamentals", "Because reserves are fixed", "Because unemployment falls"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Because fire sales reduce asset prices below fundamentals"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Forced sales can generate balance sheet losses.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**AN10) Why is distinguishing illiquidity from insolvency crucial for policy?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Because both require identical responses", answer = "Because lending to insolvent banks increases fiscal risk", "Because inflation targeting fails", "Because exchange rates fluctuate"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Because lending to insolvent banks increases fiscal risk"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Liquidity support is appropriate only for solvent institutions.</details>
</div>

## Problem Solving

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS1) A bank holds long-term mortgages funded by demand deposits. Rumours spread about losses. Why is it vulnerable to a run?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Mortgages are perfectly liquid", answer = "Depositors demand immediate withdrawal", "Equity automatically rises", "Inflation increases"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Depositors demand immediate withdrawal"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Timing mismatch creates vulnerability.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS2) A bank has assets of 100 and liabilities of 90. What is equity?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("5", answer = "10", "90", "100"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="10"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Use Assets = Liabilities + Equity.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS3) If deposit insurance is removed suddenly, what is likely to happen to depositor behaviour?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Less monitoring", answer = "More monitoring", "No change", "Guaranteed stability"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="More monitoring"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Incentives change when losses are possible.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS4) A bank suffers loan losses of 8 when equity is 10. What remains of equity?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c(answer = "2", "8", "10", "-2"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="2"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Losses reduce equity directly.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS5) During a crisis, solvent banks cannot roll over short-term funding. What should the central bank do under lender-of-last-resort principles?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Do nothing", answer = "Provide liquidity against good collateral", "Nationalise permanently", "Fix exchange rates"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Provide liquidity against good collateral"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Separate liquidity from solvency.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS6) If required capital ratio is 10% and assets equal 200, minimum equity must be:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("10", answer = "20", "30", "40"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="20"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Multiply assets by the required ratio.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS7) A bank increases leverage while asset risk rises. What happens to systemic risk?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Falls", "Unchanged", answer = "Rises", "Disappears"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Rises"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Thin capital buffers amplify shocks.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS8) If multiple banks hold similar assets and prices fall sharply, what macroeconomic effect may follow?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Stable equilibrium", answer = "Credit crunch", "Lower leverage", "Zero inflation"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Credit crunch"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Balance sheet repair reduces lending.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS9) A credible guarantee eliminates panic but encourages future risk-taking. What trade-off is illustrated?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Phillips curve trade-off", answer = "Stability vs moral hazard", "PPP vs UIP", "Inflation vs unemployment"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Stability vs moral hazard"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Insurance reduces runs but alters incentives.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**PS10) Why might higher equity requirements reduce long-run crisis probability?**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Because they eliminate deposits", answer = "Because larger buffers absorb shocks", "Because inflation falls", "Because velocity stabilises"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Because larger buffers absorb shocks"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Focus on loss-absorption capacity.</details>
</div>

## Mathematical Thinking

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT1) If reserves are 20 and required reserve ratio is 10%, maximum deposits equal:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("100", "150", answer = "200", "250"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="200"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Use the money multiplier ($\frac{1}{rr}$).</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT2) If assets = 150 and equity = 15, leverage ratio (Assets/Equity) equals:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("5", answer = "10", "15", "20"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="10"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Divide total assets by equity.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT3) If required capital ratio is 8%, and assets are 250, minimum equity equals:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("10", "15", answer = "20", "25"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="20"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Multiply assets by 0.08.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT4) If deposits are 500 and reserve ratio is 5%, required reserves equal:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("10", "20", answer = "25", "50"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="25"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Apply the reserve requirement formula.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT5) If loan losses equal 12 and initial equity was 15, new leverage rises because equity becomes:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c(answer = "3", "12", "15", "27"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="3"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Subtract losses from equity.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT6) If leverage is 20 and asset value falls by 5%, percentage decline in equity is approximately:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("5%", "20%", "50%", answer = "100%"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="100%"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>High leverage magnifies small asset shocks.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT7) If capital ratio is $\frac{E}{A} = 0.1$, leverage equals:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("5", "8", answer = "10", "12"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="10"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Leverage is the inverse of the capital ratio.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT8) If reserve ratio falls from 10% to 5%, the money multiplier:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("Falls", "Is unchanged", answer = "Doubles", "Halves"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Doubles"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Compare reciprocals.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT9) If asset prices fall by 4% and leverage is 25, equity falls by approximately:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c("4%", "10%", "25%", answer = "100%"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="100%"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Multiply percentage shock by leverage.</details>
</div>

<div class="mcq-we-q">
**MT10) If required capital ratio rises from 8% to 12%, banks must either:**  
`r webexercises::longmcq(c(answer = "Increase equity or reduce assets", "Increase deposits", "Raise inflation", "Reduce reserves"))`
<span class="mcq-key" data-correct="Increase equity or reduce assets"></span>
<details class="hint"><summary>Hint</summary>Adjust numerator or denominator of the capital ratio.</details>
</div>
